summary: Iteration 18 verified disp-1.5.0 ten-decision display change end-to-end. Full local suite passed (443/443 across /app/tests + /app/backend/tests with RK_ALLOW_PLACEHOLDER_ALPHA=1). New live-API suite backend/tests/test_iteration18_display.py (7/7 PASS) hit the deployed preview and confirmed: (1) GET /api/v2/assessments/{personality_id}/result returns position.version 'wp-1.1.0', position.floor 20.0, a 'value' on every scale row (position.scales.*.value), a read-time top-level 'loudest' that is EMPTY for the even demo profile, and no reader-surface sten. (2) GET /api/v2/assessments/{ei_id}/result returns named.mrd 0.8, named.resolved false, named.band populated, named.suppression_note populated. (3) Personality PDF renders (%PDF-, byte-identical on repeat) and its extracted text contains no ' of 10' and no 'sten N'. (4) EI PDF renders and quotes both 0.25 (spread) and 0.8 (floor). (5) Combined PDF at /api/v2/reports/combined.pdf renders, is byte-identical on repeat and carries no sten-as-mark. (6) Cross-check page /mirrors renders and quotes 0.25/0.8 for the flat EI branch — no strongest/weakest domain named. (7) Regression: other instrument sessions (essential, closeness) still return 200. Playwright UI smoke on the deployed preview also confirmed: Personality result page shows no sten anywhere in the reader-facing surface, factor rows read 'at your own middle' with a position marker (loudest-none copy present, 'no loudest' behaviour honoured), the collapsed 'How this number is built' provenance panels are present with the sten-exemption note, and the composite panel note is present. EI result page rendered the suppressed branch exactly as specified: shared band sentence 'All four domains fall between 3.0 and 3.5 on the 1-5 scale', quotes 0.25 spread and 0.8 floor, NO per-domain figures, NO per-domain bars, domain names/descriptions present, the fourteen sub-dimension names listed without figures, overall 3.19 of 5 shown, eq-domains-band and eq-suppression-note test ids both in DOM, and NO eq-domain-score-* test ids anywhere. /mirrors, /methodology and /samples surfaced no norm/band words in a claiming context (the 'percentile' hit on /methodology is inside 'No population norms, which is why no bands, categories or percentiles are shown'; the 'compared with other people' hit on /samples is inside the position_explainer disclaimer that states establishing a reference sample is work not finished — both are negating disclaimers, not norm claims).

minor.issue: The not_for_display marker (per spec: 'stens stay stored in the payload but are marked not_for_display') is generated by services/p150_lite.py at score time but is NOT re-injected at read time by routes/mirror_v2.py::_with_choosing. The demo account's stored personality snapshot pre-dates disp-1.5.0 so the marker is absent from GET /result even though the sten values are still present in factor_scores.*.sten. The reader-facing surfaces (page, PDF) correctly hide sten so there is no user-visible bug, but the review request explicitly says the marker must appear on the payload — main agent should decide whether to (a) re-inject the marker in _with_choosing for legacy snapshots, or (b) accept that only newly-scored personality carries the marker.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In routes/mirror_v2.py::_with_choosing, if result.get('instrument')=='personality' and 'not_for_display' not in result, attach the standard not_for_display block at read time so the marker is guaranteed on every personality API response including legacy snapshots. Reader-facing surfaces are already correct; this is a payload-contract completeness fix.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/mirror_v2.py _with_choosing correctly (a) recomputes loudest/strengths/blind_spots at read time so a snapshot written under an older display version cannot leak the old floor's picks, (b) attaches position from _position() at read time, (c) attaches ei_named() with facet_note and flat_copy. The one omission is the not_for_display marker — see minor issue above.

services/factor_pct.py factor_pcts() and loudest_entries() are read-time derivations that key off the reader's own profile mean and the 20 pp absolute floor — a stored result at ALGO_VERSION rk-1.0.0 remains valid because scoring is unchanged; only display was bumped to disp-1.5.0. The write-once contract on results/narratives/rendered_pdfs is respected because none of these derivations write back to Mongo.
PDF snapshot byte-identity was reconfirmed on both the personality and combined endpoints in this pass. This is the strongest signal that _score_* remained pure at rk-1.0.0 across the display bump.

The two 'norm word' matches on /methodology (percentile) and /samples (compared with other people) are inside explicit disclaimers negating the claim. If the spec ever needs a hard lint against these substrings, the copy on those two pages would need to be reworded — but as it stands the intent is correct and no reader could read them as a norm claim.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - Personality no-sten reader surface + composite panel note verified; EI suppressed branch verified with all required test ids; /mirrors and other pages regression-clean

test_credentials: ui.demo@ratherknow.com / knowmore123 (all instruments complete, demo profile is even so it exercises both the personality loudest-none path and the EI suppressed branch).
context_for_next_testing_agent: disp-1.5.0 is live and correct on the preview. ALGO_VERSION stays rk-1.0.0. Test id inventory that this pass verified in the DOM: eq-domains-band, eq-suppression-note, personality-composite-note, plus factor rows with position markers. eq-domain-score-* is correctly ABSENT for the demo account (suppressed branch). If you need to see the resolved EI branch, you must construct a fresh EI response set through the API with spread >= 0.8 — the demo account's spread is 0.25 by design. Auth: POST /api/auth/login {email,password} -> .access_token; send X-Forwarded-For unique per test client to avoid the rate limiter. The one payload-completeness gap (not_for_display marker absent from legacy personality snapshots) is the only open item; reader-facing surfaces are all clean.
rca of the issue: N/A - all reader-facing decisions verified. The one minor payload gap has a documented cause (legacy pre-1.5.0 snapshot; _with_choosing does not re-inject the marker) and a documented workaround if the main agent chooses to close it.
